messages:
IncidentBot: [PAGER] P0 generation-latency-eu triggered for service=embedder-eu, region=eu-central-1. 95th pct token latency > 2s for last 5m. Alert: https://alerts.internal/r/9876 -- paging Maya Patel (oncall)

Maya Patel: on it. seeing alert. 2s 95th sounds like degraded throughput. grabbing logs and traces.

SRE Oncall: Maya — quick checklist: 1) check node health in autoscale group; 2) verify model shards and GPU memory; 3) confirm no recent rollouts. I can run quick k8s checks if you want.

Maya Patel: yes please run checks. Alex, can you look at routing/fallback config for EU? last deploy was 23:40 UTC but not sure it touched embedder-eu.

Alex Kim: I didn't deploy embedder-eu. pulling controller logs now. if it's kernel-level slowdown might be infra.

SRE Oncall: k8s: pods 3/5 on node pool eu-g3-1 are Pending backoff, error: "nvrtc: out of memory" in pod logs. one node shows oom-kill on nvidia driver.

Jordan Li: tagging infra. scaling pool up to add spare nodes, starting cordon/drain of affected node. ETA ~4m.

Maya Patel: thanks. From a comms perspective we should prepare a brief statuspage message. Initial status: "Partial latency degradation for embeddings in eu-central-1; affecting some customers with timeouts and slow responses; mitigation in progress." Draft below — please iterate.

CommOps: Drafting statuspage snippet now. Posting suggested copy: 
```
Investigating: Increased embedding generation latency in eu-central-1
We are aware of elevated latency impacting embedding generation in the EU region. Our engineers are actively investigating. Some requests may experience timeouts or slow responses. We are scaling capacity and restarting affected nodes as part of mitigation. Impacted customers: subset of EU traffic. Next update by ~5-10 minutes or when we have a significant change.
```

Priya Singh: clean. Add note about customer-facing mitigation: "If you see high latency, retrying requests or switching to a compatible regional replica is a recommended temporary workaround."

Maya Patel: good call. Add link to statuspage and a contact for support. Also include severity P0 and affected features: embeddings + similarity search.

Alex Kim: infra update: one node had GPU driver crash after long-running kernel allocation. We suspect a memory leak introduced in a custom kernel selection path. Rolling a restart of the node pool; placing a temp routing rule to divert traffic to dedicated fallback model variant (embedder-compat-v1) in other EU AZs.

SRE Oncall: enacted routing fallback: route policy ID r-455 applied. Traffic diverted off crashed node. Monitoring qps and token latency.

Maya Patel: publishing initial statuspage now. Copy below (finalized):
```
[Investigating] Increased embedding generation latency (eu-central-1)
Status: Investigating
Impact: Some customers in EU may experience slow or failed embedding requests.
What we are doing: Engineering teams are restarting affected nodes, scaling capacity, and applying temporary routing fallback to compatible model variants to restore throughput.
Estimated next update: 10 minutes or sooner.
```
Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/incident-1769999999

CommOps: I pushed the initial update to status.redwood.ai/incidents/1769999999 and enabled notifications to subscribers. Also created a short customer-facing post for support to use: "We're experiencing increased latency for embeddings in the EU. Our teams are mitigating — you may see improved results after a retry."

Maya Patel: nice. internal note: tag affected customers via customer-impact-runbook. Alex / Jordan, please add list when you have telemetries.

Alex Kim: telemetry: large customers A, C, D show 40-60% elevated p95; smaller customers intermittently affected. Logging correlation id prefix: ez-*. I'll upload CSV to shared folder.

Jordan Li: node pool scaled +2 instances. one failed node rebooted and healthy. kernel driver version fallback applied to two nodes as rollback. Observed latency dip ~1.5m after routing fallback, but some residual tail latency remains.

Maya Patel: posting follow-up update to status: mitigation in progress, partial recovery observed, continuing to monitor.

CommOps: Posted update: 
```
[Update] Mitigation in progress — partial recovery observed
Status: Investigating
Impact: Reduced impact on some traffic after routing fallback and node restarts. A small portion of requests still experience elevated tail latency. Engineers continue to monitor and perform root cause analysis.
Next update: 15 minutes or when resolved.
```

Priya Singh: recommend adding controlled customer email to top 10 impacted accounts offering help and suggested retries. I can draft soon.

Maya Patel: yes please. Also prepare an internal postmortem template link for post-resolution. tagging postmortem-scribe.

Alex Kim: root cause initial hypothesis: regression in kernel-selection heuristic that causes oversized workspace allocation on long sequences, hitting driver OOM. I will prepare a hotfix branch to revert that heuristic.

Jordan Li: hotfix approved. Rolling patch to runtime in canary: embedder-eu-canary -> rolled to 10% traffic. Observed stability at canary after 4m.

SRE Oncall: canary looks good, no NV driver warnings. scheduling gradual rollout to 50% then 100% with 2m observation windows.

Maya Patel: once we hit 50% and no regressions, we should publish 'identified' status and ETA for full recovery.

CommOps: Agreed. Keep the customer note ready: 
```
Update for affected customers: We have identified the root cause (kernel selection regression) and rolled a hotfix to runtime. Traffic will be migrated back over the next 10-15 minutes; you should see normal latency restored. If you continue to see issues, please contact support at support@redwood.ai and include a request id.
```

Alex Kim: rollout complete to 100% at +18m from pager. Observed p95 back to normal. No errors in driver logs for last 10m.

Jordan Li: infra healthy. All nodes green.

Maya Patel: publishing resolved update. Final statuspage message: 
```
[Resolved] Embedding generation latency (eu-central-1)
Status: Resolved
Impact: Issue affected embedding generation in eu-central-1 resulting in elevated latency and some timeouts. The root cause was a regression in kernel selection that could cause oversized GPU allocations. We rolled a hotfix to the runtime and restarted affected nodes; traffic has been routed back and service is operating normally.
What we did: scaled node pool, applied routing fallback, rolled hotfix and completed a 100% rollout, monitored for stability.
Customers affected: subset of EU traffic; top impacted accounts were contacted.
Post-incident actions: follow-up postmortem and code revert/patch in progress, with timeline to be published within 72 hours.
```
Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/incident-1769999999

CommOps: Resolved notice published and notifications sent. Drafted customer email for impacted accounts and queued for sales/CS review.

Priya Singh: will send targeted emails in next 20m and coordinate credit offers if warranted.

Maya Patel: thanks everyone. Adding final internal note: please file postmortem with timeline, action items, and follow-ups. tagging postmortem-scribe and eng-runtime. Marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
